warp.bot: Use this when the user wants to see their available services, hourly rates, billable services, or manage the catalog including private and inactive rows. Results are paginated — use page/perPage and read meta.lastPage/meta.total for more, or pass search to narrow. Pass team as the team slug. Team members get the full catalog without extra flags; outsiders only see public active services.

en.answer: The stats include deals, events, news, article, and job updates for the team.

en.answer: Yes. Use it to see whether a profile has enough current customer-facing content.
